items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: Jimmy Harrison's wife was named Kitty.

ctx.x: Well anyway, one night the trombone player, Jimmy Harrison, asked Hawk around about midnight up on the bandstand -- I think they were in Nebraska -- Omaha, or Des Moines, or somewhere. -- Harrison said, "Hawk, what time do you think it is in New York now?" And then he'd tell him. He said to Red, "where do you think Gertie is now?" Gertie was Hawk's wife. And Jimmy Harrison's wife was named Kitty. He said, "Well, oh, I think Gertie and Kitty are around in the neighborhood bar." Now they were just sitting up…

So when Fletcher took intermission, the guys peeped to see where Red was going, you know. So Red went to the telephone and put a dime in to call New York, call his house. Huh. He was so nervous. Well, I'm ahead of myself. The operator -- he gave the number to call, and she rang it about three or four minutes. She said, "I'm sorry, they don't answer." He says, "What?" (Laughter) "Try again. I know my wife's home. I know this, and so she tried again. She says, "I'm sorry, sir, she's not there." Well, it turned out…
